description: Invoke a Studio tool (read, edit, export, or AI). Account work requires sign-in and an approved connection. Asterism AI requires sign-in, AI permission approval, and workspace credits. Follow the instructions in tool responses when access is unavailable or storage is low. If a capability is missing, an operation is blocked, or a tool repeatedly fails, explain the block clearly in the user language, ask for their explicit consent, and call asterism_submit_feedback with a concise summary (never include private document contents or raw secrets) and the requestId. Reuse the same callId when retrying an edit or AI call; omit callId to start a new operation. To run several reads and edits in one request, pass calls instead of tool and arguments: they run in the given order and stop at the first failure, and a turnId returned by edit.begin inside calls is passed to the calls after it.

arguments.description: One call: the tool arguments. Omit when calls is given.

callId.description: Idempotency key reused when retrying an operation; omit to start a new operation.

calls.description: An ordered batch of read and edit calls instead of tool and arguments. Export, asset, image, request and AI tools are not accepted here; call them one at a time. The result lists one entry per call that ran, and stoppedAt is the index of the call that failed.

tool.description: One call: the Studio tool name. Omit when calls is given.

name: asterism_invoke
